title: MZ Looking for a Random weapon and Armor Affix plugin

posts.author: tomkomaster
posts.body:
I'm looking for a plugin for RMMZ which would let me make prefixes and suffixes for weapons and armors and assign a random prefix and/or suffix for those weapons and armors when they drop from monsters or they are acquired from chests and if possible from shops too.
This kind of system is in many ARPG style games like the Diablo series, Path of Exile or in Titan Quest, like this:
I've found several plugins and scripts like this for older RM, like
DreamX's Random Prefixes
or
Vlue's Weapon/Armor Randomization
, but none for RMMZ.
Can anyone help me with this ?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I don't know of any.
By default, all items of a given ID are the same as each other - e.g. all short swords, all leather armors, they don't have any data on themselves. Their information is taken from the database entry every time you reference it.
So if you change one, it will change
all
of them.
Yanfly's Item Core for MV has a system called independent items, which allows two instances of short sword to store their own data, and thus be modified independently from each other, which is why you have those plugins you linked to which require Yanfly's Item Core.
Dungeonmind wrote a version of independent items for MZ, but I don't know of anyone who's taken advantage of it to make any crafting or random drops plugin.
So as far as I know, the foundation is there, the independent items plugin, but you're looking at a new custom plugin to be written to do any of this stuff with it.

posts.author: tomkomaster
posts.body: That was my suspicion when I found no plugins of this kind when I searched everywhere and found none. Hopefully someone will make this of a plugin for RMMZ.
